description: Generic vault-format upgrade. Reads surfcad.json kind and version. No step is registered, so the current version returns already_upgraded and an older or unknown version returns unsupported_vault_version. confirm: true is required only when a step is registered for that version. Never runs on open. A step result is a summary: status, commit SHAs, assemblyIds, counts, leftoverFiles paths, and warnings — not the full plan, file contents, meshes, partBindings paths, or rekey.scripts. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

confirm.description: Must be true when a vault upgrade step is registered for this version. The current version returns already_upgraded without it.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: git_upgrade_vault
